entries.note: Grimsby 2003 (PMID 12869762) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Opener untested with non-member compound, product_in_model false: fine.

Meininger 2011 (PMID 21994424) quote verbatim; Eiki 2011 model_src (PMID 21937665) reports MK-0941 lowering glucose in mice/dogs, -48% OGTT AUC. Downstream glucose readout moved in patients: same holds.
Quote verbatim. Note text cites MK-0941 16-day/4-day data, which is Eiki 2011, not the cited Grimsby 2003; tidy the note, status fine.

Kiyosue 2013 (PMID 23522182) quote verbatim; NCT01152385 results first posted 2012-08-27 confirmed. Reached-failed-abandoned row, derived_from efficacy. No AZD1656 exposure target exists, so low confidence is right.

Zhang 2013 (PMID 23263772) quote verbatim; NCT01024244 terminated 'due to nonclinical safety findings', results 2011-10-26. Model was fitted to patient MAD data, not preclinical; flip from contra rests on that. See rule question.

Abstract confirms primary endpoint was A1C at Week 14 and was met; non-sustained by week 30 correctly kept partial. AZD1656 metformin patient_trial (PMID 23464532, NCT01020123 results 2012-11-26) quote verbatim.
Kiyosue quote verbatim; primary 4-month HbA1c not significant (p=0.30). Baker 2014 (PMID 24772484) 'in marked contrast to clinical findings' confirmed. Contra beats MK-0941 same.

Vella 2019 (PMID 30651321) quote verbatim; status same under model_change is defensible. Fix fields: model_first_use_year should predate 2019 (genetic rationale guided TTP399 design); dorzagliatin is dual-acting, so its Phase 3s do not test a hepatoselective genetics model.
Opener; quote verbatim. But see missing: MK-0941 2011 triglyceride rise against a rodent model silent on lipids.
Retro status is right (De Ceuninck postdates Meininger). But the year should be 2012: Crossref shows the BJP paper online 2012 (record created 2012-08-28, published-online 2012-12-20), not 2013.

Liang 2024 quote verbatim. An earlier tier-4 meta-analysis (Frontiers Endocrinol 2023, doi 10.3389/fendo.2023.1175198) already showed GKA-raised triglycerides (WMD +0.322 mmol/L, P=0.001). The flip is blocked if the missing 2011 contra is added.

missing: safety 2011: MK-0941 raised triglycerides (and hypoglycaemia) in patients (Meininger 2011, doi 10.2337/dc11-1200), while the rodent model of record (Eiki 2011) was silent on lipids that rodents can show (De Ceuninck 2013). Arguably contra (silence contradicted), which would keep later rodent-model safety entries from flipping to same.
dose 2011: MK-0941 dose reached and the Week-14 primary met (Meininger 2011): the 'reached, drug worked' row gives dose same in 2011 before the AZD1656 contra.

efficacy patient_trials: PF-04991532 (hepatoselective member) met the 12-week HbA1c primary in NCT01336738 (450 and 750 mg vs placebo, p=0.0017 and 0.0003; results posted 2013-08-06) and NCT01338870 (results 2013-04-23). No status change.
efficacy patient_trials: PF-04937319 (nerigliatin) met the 12-week HbA1c primary at 100 mg (-0.45 to -0.47%) in two studies, Amin 2015 doi 10.1111/dom.12474. No status change.

safety: LY2599506 Phase 2s (NCT01024244, NCT01029795) were terminated for 'nonclinical safety findings'. The model flagged a harm before patients showed it, and nobody compared it in patients, so it is not scored but is worth a note.

safety: Baker 2014 (doi 10.1111/bph.12504) is a rodent model that showed no triglyceride rise, against the patient hyperlipidaemia signal. It is a second rodent result that conflicts with De Ceuninck.
rule_questions: Dose: does a semi-mechanistic model fitted to the drug's own patient MAD data (LY2599506 GIG model) count as a 'model' with model_change: true that can turn a contra cell back to same? It is a human-to-human extrapolation, not a preclinical system, and its trials stopped before efficacy was fully shown.

Safety: when a model's only public sources are pharmacology papers (no tox review, no NDA), is their silence on a harm the species can show (rodent triglycerides) enough to score contra when patients show it?

Efficacy: can a human-genetic rationale for a hepatoselective drug (TTP399) count as the model for later, non-hepatoselective members (dorzagliatin), or is it a separate model_id limited to the drugs designed from it?
Dating: TTP399 Phase 2 results were presented in 2016 (ADA), before Vella 2019. Does a conference abstract or press release set the entry year under rule 6?
